name: Before and after the paper
shape: Two columns, before and after, headed by the halves' names and spans with the paper's year in the gutter between them; one row per finding: a filled mark in the margin for what persists, a hollow mark for what changes (tagged 'at the paper' or 'later'), the sentence across the row and the two texts it rests on beneath it in their columns, named by year and title. No lines cross the text (redrawn 2026-09-07 after the owner's audit of the seam-with-lines form).
didactic: Whether the paper is a break, and what exactly changes at it, without reading the ledger.
example: Brenner 1985: deepening; 1972–1984 formation vs 1985–2025 codification; persisting: social-property relations as the object; breaking: the method (controversy → Marxian reconstruction).

evidence.note: it restates the same 1972–1984/1985–2025 split already given verbatim in L2.F1
"method" and "concepts" appear in both lists with no legend explaining partial change
crossing/stopping lines directly visualize the prose's weighing claim
